description: The agent-fabric-gateway release the fleet installs (gateway ADR-014, accepted 2026-10-10): each release is pinned by the SHA-256 of its tarball, computed by fabric-coordinator from its own download and matched against the release run whose two reproducible builds compared equal before upload, and against a separate dry run on the tagged commit, never taken from the release page alone. The install action gateway ADR-014 rules 17-19 call for (to be built as `fabric-ctl <login|all> gateway-install --version V`) will download `url` with the account's GitHub token, refuse any other digest, extract only `member`, and rename it into ~/.local/bin/agent-fabric-gateway. Moving the pin is a commit here.
